source_message.text:
Great, thanks for confirming you have the boom arm and softbox.

I’ll send over the shot list and the technical requirements for the tabletop video walkthrough. This will outline the overhead 90° setup, lighting, and the short video walk‑through while the piece is displayed. For the documentation, I need to video the three panels individually, and also the three together while they are displayed on the same black velvet tabletop used for the shoot. ( I have the velvet and table). The clips need to be edited together to produce a single 20-40 sec video. Its straightforward. I'm attaching the shot list document for added detail and clairty.

Let me know if you have questions, and we can discuss.

routing_warnings.description: This message establishes the locked 90-degree tabletop geometry and square framing rather than changing the lighting requirement.
The client approves the video as a whole, but the message does not specifically verify the softbox lighting behavior.
